installer.authorization: Injected trusted host policy required and must return true; receives normalized manifestSha256 and host-vetted origin

storage.atomicity: Adapter must serialize and atomically commit each transaction or reject without modification

extensionAccess.session: trusted host session object separately supplied
extensionAccess.grant: TaviX host-owned tavix.asset-grants/v1 projection bound to separately verified installed extension manifest + SHA-256 and trusted session; per-pack capabilities and canCustomize. Reject legacy flat grants.

wallet.scope: not implemented or simulated by this runtime

tavix.assetDependencies: TaviX 0.1.11 source validator supports explicit per-pack requests; production Tavi session bridge pending
tavix.extensionPackaging: existing .tavix extension format is not an asset-pack format
tavix.grantContract: tavix.asset-grants/v1, 16 explicit packs max, 32 capabilities per pack

dependencies.declarations: host-verified requirements only, not extension request params
dependencies.authority: readiness result cannot create entitlements, install content, or spend Gold
